item.title: Attacker who killed US troops in Syria was a recent recruit to security forces, official says
item.description: A man who carried out an attack in Syria that killed three U.S. citizens had joined Syria’s internal security forces as a base security guard two months earlier and was recently reassigned amid suspicions that he might be affiliated with the Islamic State group, a Syrian official told The Associated Press Sunday.

item.title: Zelenskyy offers to drop NATO bid for security guarantees but rejects US push to cede territory
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Sunday voiced readiness to drop his country’s bid to join NATO in exchange for Western security guarantees, but rejected the U.S. push for ceding territory to Russia as he held talks with U.S. envoys on ending the war.

item.title: Gunmen kill at least 15 people in attack on Hanukkah celebration on Sydney’s Bondi Beach
item.description: Two gunmen opened fire during a Hanukkah celebration on Sydney's Bondi beach, killing 15 people, including a child, officials said Monday, in what Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called an act of antisemitic terrorism that struck at the heart of the nation.

item.title: JetBlue flight near Venezuela avoids ‘midair collision’ with US Air Force tanker
item.description: “We almost had a midair collision up here,” the JetBlue pilot said, according to a recording of his conversation with air traffic control. “They passed directly in our flight path. ... They don’t have their transponder turned on, it’s outrageous.”

item.title: Person of interest detained in Brown University shooting that killed 2 and wounded 9
item.description: A person of interest was in custody Sunday after a shooting during final exams at Brown University that killed two students and wounded nine others, though key questions remained unanswered nearly 24 hours after the attack.

item.title: ‘Zootopia 2’ reclaims No. 1 spot at box office, grosses $1B worldwide
item.description: “Zootopia 2” regained the No. 1 spot at the domestic box office with $26.3 million in its third weekend of release, according to studio estimates Sunday, as The Walt Disney Co. animated sequel became the year’s second film to gross $1 billion worldwide.

item.title: Hanukkah celebrations start in downtown Wilmington
item.description: Hanukkah celebrations have officially begun in downtown Wilmington, with lighting the first candle of the Menorah.

item.title: Warming Shelter ILM opened with two locations
item.description: Warming Shelter ILM opens with two new locations, and plenty of space for people to stay overnight.

item.title: Maple Hill’s woman celebrates her 100th birthday
item.description: Annie Elizabeth Shepard Hayes celebrated her 100th birthday on Sunday, held at Lee's Chapel Missionary Baptist Church.

item.title: Ogden residents give Waffle House waitress early Christmas gifts
item.description: 70-year-old Rose Wiest began working at a Waffle House in May, after her husband Dennis died back in April.
